notes: v3: explain-and-approve workflow (red to-do -> note -> approve -> orange un-mapped bucket), CSV export to accounting, notes.json bake loop (build_data --notes / input-dir notes.json), units reframed (purchased-to-job + from-stock) vs sold. Fleet value change is an approvable standing item. v3.1: Trailing 60 window; over-pull aging — soft orange grace ≤3 days after job close (weekend catch-up), hard red day 4+. v3.2: window anchor = built-date minus one (never a partial today); T90 feeds live. build_data.py frozen in repo (plaintext, no secrets) — nightly runs fetch + sha-verify it; edits bump build_plain_sha256. v3.4: null-guards on DATA.month — with <2 stock snapshots the month anchor degrades to an 'unavailable' note instead of throwing on load (blank page); nightly runs now stage the month-end Aggregate Inventory Stock Reports from Claude Docs/Inventory Month End/_Input (engine picks the 2 newest by Filters date) and headless-render-verify before publish. v4.0: JOB-STATUS FIX — completion resolved from the movement export Job Status column (2,407 jobs/90d) instead of the MTD Job Costing file (490 jobs); 289 equipment POs restated open->matched, only 2 genuinely open. Router fix: Units Installed claimed on Completion Date; invoice-item files content-deduped ('Jobs trailing 90 days' and 'Real Discounts' ship identical headers AND identical payloads). New: bill-of-materials engine off sold invoice TASK names (Split Gas=cond+coil+furnace, Split HP=cond+AH, package=1, water heater=1 incl. Tankless System Swap Out, water purity=1 standalone / 2 refiner+softener; IAQ Package excluded). Ledger restructured into 4 movement buckets (consumed on job / returned / missing / received) with per-type unit+value and item drilldown; returned is txn-scope (no item detail in feed). Three-tier variance: branch, per-job-per-class, itemization. Sign-aware half-up quantity rounding with partial/reversal rule violations surfaced by job. v4.1: ALL new sections now obey the window filter (ledger buckets, branch + per-job variance, quantity violations moved into renderAll and recomputed client-side per window). Variance anchors on the job COMPLETION date (fallback: earliest PO date -> invoice-equipment date -> sold date; endEst marks fallbacks) so a PO dated 7/21 is not split from a job closing 7/22. Class universe for the windowed branch recompute is pinned to the engine list — a free recompute leaked WP Faucet (AG) (33 stock units) past the RO-faucet exclusion and inflated variance +61 -> +98. 65 jobs carry no date in ANY feed and are surfaced in a visible note rather than silently dropped.
